answer: A sybil must fund fresh identities, and every fake account burns real stake plus an umber-tinted audit trail linking shared infrastructure. One concrete mechanism: require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and post a unique hardware-backed attestation whose rotation history is publicly anchored. Only a plume of independently verified stake raises the trust signal, so forgery costs scale linearly with the number of identities an attacker needs. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
